name: T-Mobile Military Discount
description: Discounted unlimited plans for military and veteran families (about $720/year savings with 4 lines)
fullDescription: T-Mobile offers Military Savings on its Experience More and Experience Beyond unlimited plans for military members, veterans, and their families, with streaming perks on select plans.
whatTheyOffer:
- Experience More and Experience Beyond plans with Military Savings
- Save about $720/year with 4 lines compared to regular Experience plans
- Netflix Standard with ads and Hulu included on Experience Beyond
- Unlimited 5G data, talk, and text
howToGetIt:
1. Visit a T-Mobile store or t-mobile.com/cell-phone-plans/military-discount-plans
2. Choose an Experience plan with Military Savings
3. Verify military status for the account holder within 45 days
4. Maintain a valid military line on the account, or lines may cost up to $20/line/month more
keywords: T-Mobile, military discount, veteran, active duty, National Guard, Reserve, Experience More, Experience Beyond, cell phone, wireless plan
